description: This file provides utilities for connecting to a MongoDB database, initializing indexes, and holding references to the client and database objects for use in a manufacturing defect management system.

classes.name: Mongo
classes.description: A dataclass that encapsulates a MongoDB client and database handle for persistent connection management.

methods.name: None init_indexes(db: Database)
methods.description: Creates indexes on various collections to optimize queries; designed to be idempotent.

parameters.name: db
parameters.description: The database object on which indexes are created.

methods.name: Mongo create_mongo(mongodb_url: str, mongodb_db: str)
methods.description: Establishes a connection to MongoDB and initializes indexes, returning a Mongo instance containing the client and database handle.

parameters.name: mongodb_db
parameters.description: The name of the database to connect to.
